requirements.title: GET_COMMAND argument restrictions
requirements.definition: COMMAND and ERRMSG shall be default character scalars, LENGTH and STATUS shall be integer scalars with decimal exponent range at least four, and the listed intents apply.

pending.GET_COMMAND-COMMAND-default-character-sc: Positive source-control plan calls GET_COMMAND with a default character scalar COMMAND sentinel; mutation changes COMMAND to an array or nondefault kind and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.GET_COMMAND-LENGTH-integer-scalar-range: Positive source-control plan calls GET_COMMAND with an integer scalar LENGTH sentinel such as -7777; mutation changes LENGTH to real and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.GET_COMMAND-STATUS-integer-scalar-range: Positive source-control plan calls GET_COMMAND with an integer scalar STATUS sentinel such as -7777; mutation changes STATUS to logical and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.GET_COMMAND-ERRMSG-default-character-sca: Positive source-control plan calls GET_COMMAND with a default character scalar ERRMSG prefilled with a nonblank sentinel; mutation changes ERRMSG to an array and claims no diagnostic facet.
